STAT 374: Quantitative Foundations for Finance
Description: This course introduces analytical and statistical methods commonly used in finance, with applications to investment management and corporate finance.
Requirements: Prereq: MATH 136, STAT 231 with a grade of 60% or STAT 241; Computing & Financial Management or Math/CPA students only. Antireq: STAT 321, 331, 371, 443, AFM 323/STAT 374
